solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/to-lower-case/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

709. To Lower Case

Given a string s, return the string after replacing every uppercase letter with the same lowercase letter.

Example 1:

Input: s = "Hello"
Output: "hello"

Example 2:

Input: s = "here"
Output: "here"

Example 3:

Input: s = "LOVELY"
Output: "lovely"

Constraints:

    1 <= s.length <= 100
    s consists of printable ASCII characters.
"""


class Solution:
    def toLowerCase(self, s: str) -> str:
        return s.lower()


sol = Solution()

print(sol.toLowerCase("Hello"))  # "hello"

assert sol.toLowerCase("Hello") == "hello"
assert sol.toLowerCase("here") == "here"
assert sol.toLowerCase("LOVELY") == "lovely"

assert sol.toLowerCase("") == ""
assert sol.toLowerCase("A") == "a"
assert sol.toLowerCase("Z") == "z"
assert sol.toLowerCase("a") == "a"
assert sol.toLowerCase("z") == "z"
assert sol.toLowerCase("1234") == "1234"
assert sol.toLowerCase("!@#$%^&*()") == "!@#$%^&*()"
assert sol.toLowerCase("MiXeD CaSe 123") == "mixed case 123"
assert sol.toLowerCase("ALLUPPERCASELETTERS") == "alluppercaseletters"
assert sol.toLowerCase("alllowercaseletters") == "alllowercaseletters"
assert sol.toLowerCase("123ABCdef!@#") == "123abcdef!@#"
assert (
    sol.toLowerCase("A" * 100)
    == "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
)
